text:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up: OrionPay onboarding — p50 180ms, p95 980ms, token cost ~2.1x. Customer says accuracy is fine but latency blocks checkout flow. Renewal in 50d. Looking for quick wins: quant/model swap/routing. Thoughts?
Arjun (ML Eng): Low-risk path: 10% q4 canary on representative endpoints + 20% redwood-v2-small perf test. Run eval on their prompt set first.
Priya (Solutions): They run in us-east-1 on mixed A10/A100 fleet; some endpoints use ~2.5k context. Any KV/cold-start caveats?
Leo (Infra): KV cold-starts will spike p95. Add warmup replay and short-lived mem bump during rollout. q4 reduces mem ~35% typically.
Arjun (ML Eng): Proposed simple routing snippet:
```yaml
routing:
  - match: customer_id == "orionpay"
    split: {"redwood-v2-base":80, "redwood-v2-base-q4":10, "redwood-v2-small":10}
    monitor: [p95_latency_ms, error_rate, quality_delta]
    window: 48h
```
Sam (AE): Orion said: "if checkout lags we pause the rollout". Target p95 <800ms to feel safe.
Ethan (Observability): I'll spin up a canary dashboard + autoremove alert: p95 >850ms -> slack #customer-success; error_rate >1% -> auto-rollback. I'll also run synthetic warmup traffic before start.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary 2026-05-10T11:00:00Z at 10% q4 + 10% small. Health checks: p95, errors, quality_delta. Console link: https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/orionpay-3320000011
Maya (CSM): Plan: 1) Eval q4 on orionpay_prompts 2) Launch 10% q4 + 10% small with warmup 3) Monitor p95/errors/quality_delta 4) If stable, ramp over 48-72h. Priya/Sam: you own comms. Arjun/Leo/Ethan: ops + rollback hooks. Agreed?
Priya (Solutions): Agreed. I'll produce a short tech note for the customer.
Arjun (ML Eng): Starting eval & perf bench now.
Leo (Infra): Scheduling warmup replay 30m pre-rollout.
Ethan (Observability): Dashboard will be posted in this thread when ready."
